senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עוּד)turn, continuation; (prep.) up to, until, during, while; in place of.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 87a:19">B. Mets. 87ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107b:17">Snh. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>עד אברהם</he> up to Abraham’s time, v. <cite ref="G00646"><he>זִקְנָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 55a:1">B. Kam. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שאתה שואלני וכ׳</he> during the time that &c., instead of asking me &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 58:2">Gen. R. s. 58</cite> <he>עד שלא ישקיע וכ׳</he> before yet the Lord causes the sun of one righteous man to set, he causes that of another to rise.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 29b:18">Kidd. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>עד כ׳ שנה</he> until a person is twenty years old.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:9">Ib. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>עד היכן כיבוד וכ׳</he> how far does the duty of honoring parents go?; a. v. fr.—

Ber. 26ᵇ (ref. to ib. IV, 1 ‘up to four hours’) עד וָעַד בכלל וכ׳ does it mean ‘up to’, and that ‘up to’ included, i.e. including the whole fourth hour of the day, or excluding the fourth hour? Nidd. 58ᵇ לימא בעד ועד בכלל קמיפלגי shall we say, their difference turns on the question whether ‘until’ is meant to include or to exclude the terminus? Ib. איכא עד ועד בכלל ואיכא עד ולא עד בכלל sometimes ‘until’ means inclusive of, and sometimes exclusive of.
Ib. קמיפלגי בעד ועד דהכא they differ as to the meaning of the word ‘until’ in this case (in the Mishnah); a. fr.—בַּעַד, בְּעַד (cmp. עֲבוּר) in behalf of, for, about.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:2-16">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite> <he>וכי … הפונדק בַּעֲדֵינוּ</he> (our w. missing in ed. Bub.) has that innkeeper opened his shop for the first time today, for our benefit? <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 12:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XII</cite> <he>שאל בַּעֲדוֹ וכ׳</he> he inquired about him, where is he?; a. e.—<cite ref="F00070"><he>וָעֶד</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P00266"><he>עוֹלָם</he></cite>.
